title: Burning Midnight Oil
statementMd:
One day a highly important task was commissioned to Vasya — writing a program in a night. The program consists of $*n*$ lines of code. Vasya is already exhausted, so he works like that: first he writes $*v*$ lines of code, drinks a cup of tea, then he writes as much as ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/837a798d4a0c3fe486d62834783caae40b612564.png) lines, drinks another cup of tea, then he writes ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6304306dbf5ca2b95ecc97210a073c7ce7046290.png) lines and so on: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cdc02455a9281e93e689009c03121270d92d1bc.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92bb2b6b977058290f73ae4b98682b9f08f27633.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/858a837a4b30b8578ae73e5bde2c4e213fa93c32.png), ...

The expression ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b5e5ef3e6404b5c0e793de54b932298d1825cced.png) is regarded as the integral part from dividing number $*a*$ by number $*b*$.

The moment the current value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c126a89a41a4df209f523e85223b11f89735ebba.png) equals 0, Vasya immediately falls asleep and he wakes up only in the morning, when the program should already be finished.

Vasya is wondering, what minimum allowable value $*v*$ can take to let him write **not less** than $*n*$ lines of code before he falls asleep.

## Input

The input consists of two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$, separated by spaces — the size of the program in lines and the productivity reduction coefficient, $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$, $2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10$.

## Output

Print the only integer — the minimum value of $*v*$ that lets Vasya write the program in one night.

## Note

In the first sample the answer is $*v* = 4$. Vasya writes the code in the following portions: first $4$ lines, then $2$, then $1$, and then Vasya falls asleep. Thus, he manages to write $4 + 2 + 1 = 7$ lines in a night and complete the task.

In the second sample the answer is $*v* = 54$. Vasya writes the code in the following portions: $54$, $6$. The total sum is $54 + 6 = 60$, that's even more than $*n* = 59$.
statementZhMd:
某天，Vasya 接到了一项极其重要的任务——在一夜之间编写一个程序。这个程序包含 $*n*$ 行代码。Vasya 已经筋疲力尽，因此他的工作方式如下：首先编写 $*v*$ 行代码，喝一杯茶；然后编写 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/837a798d4a0c3fe486d62834783caae40b612564.png) 行代码，再喝一杯茶；接着编写 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6304306dbf5ca2b95ecc97210a073c7ce7046290.png) 行代码，依此类推：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cdc02455a9281e93e689009c03121270d92d1bc.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/92bb2b6b977058290f73ae4b98682b9f08f27633.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/858a837a4b30b8578ae73e5bde2c4e213fa93c32.png)、……

表达式 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b5e5ef3e6404b5c0e793de54b932298d1825cced.png) 表示数字 $*a*$ 除以数字 $*b*$ 所得商的整数部分。

当当前值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c126a89a41a4df209f523e85223b11f89735ebba.png) 等于 0 时，Vasya 会立即睡着，并且只有在早晨才会醒来，而那时程序本应已经完成。

Vasya 想知道，为了让自己在睡着之前编写**不少于** $*n*$ 行代码，$*v*$ 最小可以取多少。

## 输入

输入包含两个由空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$ ——程序的代码行数以及生产力下降系数，$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$，$2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10$。

## 输出

输出唯一一个整数——使 Vasya 能在一夜之间完成程序的 $*v*$ 的最小值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，答案是 $*v* = 4$。Vasya 按以下批次编写代码：首先是 $4$ 行，然后是 $2$ 行，接着是 $1$ 行，之后 Vasya 便睡着了。因此，他一夜之间总共编写了 $4 + 2 + 1 = 7$ 行代码，完成了任务。

在第二个样例中，答案是 $*v* = 54$。Vasya 按以下批次编写代码：$54$ 行、$6$ 行。总和为 $54 + 6 = 60$，这甚至超过了 $*n* = 59$。
